description: A missing layer-four operation is identified as a Newton-chart transition. In the stored specialization, the resulting layer-five-through-seven support and matching equations have no solution over the algebraic closure of the coefficient field.

independent_review.scope: No independent review is represented in this public record.

manuscript_coverage.coverage_rule: Complete coverage requires an exact LaTeX location for every program-relevant defining claim. A locator records where the current statement and evidence boundary appear; it is not a proof-review status.

members.statement: The formally invertible change W=M0/(AB), T=sW^(1/S), H=(alpha log(B/B0)-beta log(A/A0))/S converts the full single-component determinant equation into a linear equation in H and W and decouples all normal orders before support restrictions.
members.title: Exact Normal Coordinates Linearize Every Boundary Order

members.statement: For every r at least 5 in the full (8,28) windows, the terminal layer operator is injective; for 5 at most r at most 11 its cokernel has dimension r-1.
members.title: The Full (8,28) Terminal Layer Maps Are Injective

members.statement: For the stored degree-21 terminal face, the one-dimensional layer-four residual kernel is not realized by a fixed-chart algebraic operation; it is the k=4 complete-chain rechart, after which the adjacent-chart Jacobian equations force L=0, F5=0, and a common approximate root P2=C R^2, Q3=G R^3.
members.title: The Missing Layer-Four Operation Is the k=4 Newton-Chart Transition

members.statement: After the canonical k=4 rechart and forced adjacent-chart condition, the complete layer-five-through-seven support and chart-matching equations of the stored degree-21 full-support terminal specialization have no solution over the algebraic closure of its quintic coefficient field.
members.title: The Stored Degree-21 Terminal Model Is Excluded Through Layer Seven
